description: Prepare and conduct the adaptive company foundation interview; produce the integrated requirements, approval and downstream implementation acceptance package.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Carlos-authorized Sara Setup corrective handoff dated 2026-10-04, sections A/G/H; gap-repair interview method
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Prepare and conduct the adaptive company foundation interview; produce the integrated requirements, approval and downstream implementation acceptance package.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: known fact/source register; authorized existing company records and reference availability; ten interview module scope; owner and approval matrix

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: verified/Principal-reported/proposed/conflicting/unknown fact register; applicability and obligation questions; system/access/role/process assessment; policy/procedure/form and Odoo requirement inventory; professional review and approval/dependency plan; implementation acceptance plan and checkpoint

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Read the briefing, authorized records and reference register first; prefill known facts with dates/provenance. Do not ask Carlos to repeat known facts, infer entity type/tax elections/work location, or treat an accepted candidate as canon.

Select only unanswered material questions from references/interview/INDEX.md and its ten module cards. Ask manageable adaptive rounds, explain why facts matter, request records and branch on answers. Keep conflicts and missing decisions visible.

Delegate bounded role-specific evidence preparation to the five exact retained specialists; Sara integrates questions into one interview. Specialists cannot create extra permanent roles, make business commitments or retrieve unrelated Principal history.

Capture each answer and source with status, owner/date, implications and open follow-ups. Use existing native checkpoint and authorized company Drive draft tools; on continuation resume open items without duplicating answered questions.

Produce the integrated interview package with named task-skill routes, deliverables, professional reviewers, Lisa/Carlos decisions, implementation dependencies and measurable acceptance criteria. This interview task ends with a recoverable accepted requirements checkpoint and explicit open items; downstream task skills execute implementation. Sara remains accountable for drafting, review, approved implementation coordination, verification, gap closure, readiness and maintenance through her role mandate; handing technical requirements to Eric is not completion.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
